title: AgentProposal
description: Formal schema for zero-authority capability proposals generated by autonomous agents, models, or planners. Proposes a capability invocation (C, theta, H_pre), not arbitrary state mutations.

agent_id.description: Identity of the agent, subagent, model, or planner.

capability_id.description: Canonical identifier of the target capability to invoke (e.g. inventory.reserve).

capability_version.description: SemVer version constraint for the capability (e.g. ^1.2.0).

pre_state_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 fingerprint of WorldState at time of proposal generation.

arguments.description: Typed arguments proposed for the capability invocation theta.

goal_context.description: Identifier or description of active goal motivating this proposal.

predicted_outcome.description: Agent-predicted next state or transition effect for calibration; NEVER applied directly as authoritative transition.

proposed_state_hash.description: Agent-predicted next state hash (subject to authoritative verification).

reasoning_trace.description: Optional chain-of-thought, heuristic score, or rationale justification.
